title: GambleBar
description: Premium drink gambling GUI for Paper/Spigot with Vault economy and anti-abuse payout protection.
body:
# 🍸 GambleBar

GambleBar is a fast economy mini-game for Paper/Spigot servers: players buy drinks in a GUI and roll for payouts.

## ✨ Core Features
- 4 configurable drinks with different risk profiles
- Vault economy payments and random payouts
- Anti-abuse protections (cooldowns, payout caps, hourly profit cap, processing lock)
- Player stats and admin reload command

## ✅ Requirements
- Java 17+
- Paper/Spigot/Purpur/Folia server
- Vault plugin installed and enabled
- One Vault-compatible economy plugin installed and enabled (EssentialsX Economy, CMI, etc.)

## ⚠️ Important
If Vault or an economy provider is missing, GambleBar will not work and will disable itself for safety.

## ⚙️ Troubleshooting
1. Run `/plugins` and verify `Vault` and your economy plugin are green.
2. Start order matters: Vault and economy must load before GambleBar.
3. Check server console for "No Vault economy provider found".

## 📄 Commands
- `/gamblebar`
- `/gamblebar stats [player]`
- `/gamblebar reload`

## 🔒 Permissions
- `gamblebar.use`
- `gamblebar.admin`

## ☕ Support
https://buymeacoffee.com/perusi
